note: Original fan-written achievement titles and lore for the potion mastery collection.

0-0.title: First Spark of the Red Spring
0-0.lore: At its final refinement, one scarlet drop restores the warmth of dawn to a fading heartbeat.

0-1.title: Cradle of the Second Heart
0-1.lore: The perfected baby tonic is said to hush every fever and lend the smallest heart a brave new beat.

0-2.title: Raspberry Rebirth
0-2.lore: Its ripe red sweetness carries a lost traveler back from the edge, laughing and berry-stained.

0-3.title: Pocket Heartfire
0-3.lore: A thumb-sized bottle holds enough red flame to rekindle a hero between one breath and the next.

0-4.title: Collagen's Silken Second Skin

0-7.title: Cherry Comet Reborn

0-8.title: The Red Giant's Heart
0-8.lore: A single perfected draught beats with the force of a crimson sun rising inside the drinker.

0-9.title: Benediction of the Scarlet Saint
0-9.lore: Its final blessing glows through the bottle and turns a dying spark into a chorus of heartbeats.

0-10.title: Strawberry Phoenix
0-10.lore: From its fragrant red foam, the drinker rises renewed, as if life itself had grown wings.

0-11.title: Strength in the Blood
0-11.lore: The perfected elixir floods every vein with the steadfast might of a mountain that refuses to fall.

0-12.title: Radiant Lifeblood

0-13.title: The Reforged Heart
0-13.lore: This advanced red brew tempers every wound into a stronger beat, bright as newly forged steel.

0-14.title: Ashwalker's Vow

0-15.title: Crimson Reserve
0-15.lore: Rich with stored vitality, the finished potion keeps a second life waiting beneath its dark red surface.

0-16.title: Wrath in the Veins
0-16.lore: The final scarlet surge turns anger into living force, fierce enough to outlast the battle that summoned it.

0-17.title: Heaven's Last Heartbeat
0-17.lore: A celestial pulse answers the bottle's glow, lending mortal life the persistence of the stars.

0-18.title: The First Pulse
0-18.lore: Older than written alchemy, this ancient red essence remembers the first heartbeat ever heard.

0-19.title: Blood of the Ballad
0-19.lore: Its legendary finish gives the fallen one more verse, sung in a voice that will not fade.

0-20.title: Dawn in the Veins
0-20.lore: The perfected elixir pours a new sunrise through the body, and night has nowhere left to hide.

0-21.title: The Red Curse Unbound
0-21.lore: Mastered at last, the bloody reagent twists its curse into a fierce red shield around its bearer.

0-22.title: The Demon's Crimson Bargain
0-22.lore: A devil's small promise becomes immense: one sip, and a failing heart bargains its way back to fire.

0-23.title: Red Plague: The Curefire
0-23.lore: At its epitome, the serum burns through the crimson blight and leaves only a clean, living pulse.

0-24.title: Pride's Crimson Crown
0-24.lore: The final red essence crowns its bearer with such vitality that even old wounds bow and close.

1-0.title: First Tide of the Blue Spring
1-0.lore: Perfected to its purest blue, the first tide clears a fogged mind like moonlight over water.

1-1.title: Cradle of Quiet Thought
1-1.lore: The infant-sized draught gathers scattered thoughts gently, like stars tucked into a blanket.

1-2.title: Blueberry Blue Hour

1-3.title: Pocket Current
1-3.lore: A small sapphire spark keeps the stream of magic flowing through the most demanding incantation.

1-4.title: Stonebound Current

1-5.title: Hearth of Clear Thought
1-5.lore: This homely blue brew brings a wandering mind back to its hearth, calm and ready to kindle again.

1-6.title: The Steady Mind

1-7.title: Soda of the Blue Comet

1-9.title: Benediction of the Sapphire Star

1-12.title: Luminous Thought

1-18.title: Memory of the First Sea
1-18.lore: This ancient potion remembers the world's first ocean and restores the boundless mana that flowed within it.

1-19.title: The Dreamweaver's Flood
1-19.lore: Fantasy spills from the mastered elixir in a tide of mana, turning impossible visions into spells.

1-20.title: Daybreak in the Deep
1-20.lore: A blue dawn opens behind the eyes, refreshing the mind with the promise of another thousand spells.

1-21.title: Ashen Mnemonic
1-21.lore: The cursed ash settles into a secret script; its perfected blue spark remembers every lost incantation.

1-22.title: The Demon's Blue Spark
1-22.lore: A devil's pinch of mana becomes a storm-bright reserve, enough to make even forbidden runes sing.

1-23.title: Blue Plague: Fever of Dreams
1-23.lore: At full potency, the strange serum turns its fever into a lucid tide of magic that floods every thought.

1-24.title: Pride's Sapphire Crown

2-0.title: First Ember of the Golden Spring
2-0.lore: Perfected to a golden spark, the first ember carries tired feet through one more impossible mile.

2-1.title: Cradle of the Little Flame
2-1.lore: The smallest bright draught shelters a tender spark until it can blaze into a tireless stride.

2-2.title: Citrus Sprint
2-2.lore: Its orange zest becomes a streak of sunlight, carrying the drinker past every looming finish line.

2-3.title: Pocket Furnace

2-4.title: Sunfruit's Endurance

2-5.title: Hearthfire Reserve
2-5.lore: This homegrown warmth stores a banked fire in the legs for journeys that refuse to end.

2-6.title: The Surefoot's Breath

2-7.title: Lemonbolt Fizz

2-11.title: A Sun Within

2-12.title: Brightfoot Radiance

2-13.title: The Unbroken Stride
2-13.lore: Mastered at last, this advanced brew carries its runner forward through any distance without faltering.

2-14.title: Stormrunner's Vow

2-15.title: The Golden Reserve
2-15.lore: Enriched to its utmost, this potion keeps a deep store of stamina glowing beneath its amber surface.

2-16.title: Lionheart Vigor

2-17.title: The Sky's Second Wind

2-18.title: The Old Road's Endless Step

2-19.title: The Hero's Last Stand
2-19.lore: When the final battle drains all strength, this elixir gives the hero one more legendary charge.

2-20.title: Twilight's Final Sprint
2-20.lore: As daylight fades, the perfected elixir lights one last golden path and carries its runner to safety.

2-21.title: The Sunset Curse Unbound
2-21.lore: Mastery breaks the sunset curse, turning its fading gold into a fierce, unspent flame.

2-22.title: The Demon's Burning Step
2-22.lore: A devil's small spark becomes a furnace in the heels, burning away every trace of weariness.

2-23.title: Yellow Plague: The Last Light
2-23.lore: At its epitome, the feverish serum becomes a bright reserve that keeps the last light burning.

2-24.title: Pride's Golden Crown
2-24.lore: The perfected golden essence crowns its bearer with a tireless stride worthy of the sun itself.
